description: Pre-1.0.0 major-protection is overridden by an explicit major release request. When the caller explicitly forces a major release, a project below 1.0.0 is promoted to 1.0.0 even though the automatic path would have refused. Input gives a starting version below 1.0.0, a breaking-change commit, and an explicit major release request; output reports the resulting version.
